topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna allows for flexible frequency planning, supporting various broadband satellite link configurations. It can accommodate a minimum bandwidth of 1 MHz for inter-satellite links, enhancing spectral efficiency.
reference_context: CTS antennas offer 52.9% relative bandwidth, and inter-satellite links require a minimum 1 MHz bandwidth, influencing satellite communication system design.
